checks.claim: OS Net base-station coordinate standard errors are generally better than 0.008 m in plan.
OS Net base-station height standard errors are generally better than 0.020 m.
OSTN15 defines OSGB36 National Grid with OS Net stations.
OSTN15 agrees with old triangulation network stations at about 0.1 m RMS for Great Britain.
OSGM15 standard error for Great Britain vertical datum is 0.008 m, excluding GNSS heighting errors.
OS Terrain 5 uses 5 m post spacing.
OS Terrain 5 provides 5 m interval contours.
OS Terrain 5 is updated every three months.
Typical Terrain 5 accuracy is greater than 2 m RMSE.
Terrain 5 is a coarser independent cross-check and not a replacement for 1 m EA DTM parcel-ground sampling.
